ds:335:30:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sağ ol dostum! Antrenmana başlayınca bir de gör!

ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Şey, biraz toparlanmam lazım. Çok iş yaptım.

ds:335:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.
ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Şey, biraz toparlanmam lazım. Çok iş yaptım.

ds:335:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:336:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! Dang Rascal, I couldn’t touch you!

ds:336:149:Dialogue Text.source: I suppose I learn from the best!

ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re gonna be great at this! I’ll let you know when I get better routines set up!
ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hah! Bu işte harika olacaksın! Daha iyi programlar hazırladığımda haber vereceğim!

ds:336:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hehehe… I’ve got a lot of fun stuff planned…

ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]True, but I usually hit folks a lot more than that!
ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Doğru ama genelde çok daha fazla vururum!

ds:336:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, I got ya a few times eh?

ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you could do better next time?
ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bir dahaki sefere daha iyisini yapabilir misin?

ds:336:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Rascal, mate, I’ll be honest. That was pathetic!

ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, you can only go up from here, right?
ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ama hey, buradan sonra ancak yükselirsin, değil mi?

ds:336:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s give it another shot when you’re ready.

ds:336:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve got a fun lil’ routine set up.

ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect, so you should be familiar with how to move your body pretty well, yeah?
ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mükemmel, o zaman vücudunu nasıl hareket ettireceğini iyi biliyor olmalısın, ha?

ds:336:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oy! Ya ready to give this a shot?

ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! For now I’ve prepared this Practice Routine. Let’s get started!
ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Harika! Şimdilik şu Alıştırma Programını hazırladım. Başlayalım!

ds:336:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna try to PELT YOU with ACORNS!

ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For this first round, we’ll just see how you fare for 30 seconds!
ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bu ilk turda sadece 30 saniyede nasıl idare ettiğine bakacağız!

ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.source: Uhhh, I don’t like the sound of this…
ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.target: Şey, bu kulağa pek hoş gelmedi…

ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Psssh, don’t worry mate, it’ll be fine!
ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Peş, merak etme dostum, bir şey olmaz!

ds:336:56:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know when you’re ready to get started!

ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I see, well, we just got this order in, so we’ll probably sit this one out.
ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Anladım, bu siparişi yeni aldık, bu seferlik katılmayız herhâlde.

ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s no rush!
You guys can join us.
ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.target:
Acele yok!
Siz de bize katılabilirsiniz.

ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s okay Rascal, we can’t exactly all ride Penny anyways. We’ll head over once we’re finished here.
ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sorun değil Afacan, zaten hepimiz birden Penny’ye binemeyiz. Buradaki işimiz bitince geliriz.

ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Yep. Besides… that place kind of gives me the creeps…

ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, we’ll be sure to catch you two up then!
ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tamam, o zaman size de olanları anlatırız!

ds:337:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Come quick! There’s something going on at the ruins!

ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Whoa, what do you mean? Is something wrong?
ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Vay, ne demek istiyorsun? Bir sorun mu var?

ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Augustus just told me to round up all the critters! He seemed very excited.
ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Augustus bütün hayvancıkları toplamamı söyledi! Çok heyecanlı görünüyordu.

ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh! What could all this be about?

ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Do check on the other critters… they seem a bit more worried…
ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Diğer hayvancıklara da bak… onlar biraz daha endişeli görünüyor…

ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow check this out! The symbols are glowing!

ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No idea what this is about, but I’m pretty excited!
ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ne olduğu hakkında fikrim yok ama çok heyecanlıyım!

ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, nothing really happens here too often… So I’m a bit more excited than worried about it…
ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Açıkçası burada pek sık bir şey olmaz… O yüzden endişeden çok heyecan duyuyorum…

ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Besides! If anything bad happens, I can just fly away! See ya!
ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hem! Kötü bir şey olursa uçup giderim! Görüşürüz!

ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure nothing bad will come of this… Right?
ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Eminim bundan kötü bir şey çıkmaz… Değil mi?

ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And if something bad happens… We’ll figure it out together! We’re a scrappy bunch!
ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kötü bir şey olursa da… Birlikte çözeriz! Mücadeleci bir grubuz!

ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon love, there’s no need to get worked up just yet…

ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]*Sigh* I’m sorry dear, I’m just on edge… This is very strange…
ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]*İç çeker* Kusura bakma canım, sadece gerginim… Bu çok tuhaf…

ds:339:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I know, love. But we’ll be ok…

ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh Rascal, I’m glad to see you here. Look at what’s happening!
ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ah Afacan, seni burada gördüğüme sevindim. Olanlara bak!

ds:339:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ve got a bad feeling about this…

ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm, I don’t mean to snip dear, but I’ve been here my whole life and haven’t seen anything like this.
ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hımm, terslemek istemem canım ama bütün ömrümü burada geçirdim, böyle bir şey hiç görmedim.

ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If there was ever a time for concern, this is a pretty good one…
ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Endişelenmek için bir zaman varsa o da şimdi…

ds:33:22:Dialogue Text.source: … Yeah, definitely not going in there.

ds:340:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope we didn’t do anything wrong…

ds:340:5:Dialogue Text.source: What do you think about it?

ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These ruins have been here for so long… and we don’t know enough about them… What if we did something wrong?
ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bu harabeler çok uzun zamandır burada… haklarında yeterince şey bilmiyoruz… Ya yanlış bir şey yaptıysak?

ds:341:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What do you think it could be?? A sign? A warning?
ds:341:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sence ne olabilir?? Bir işaret mi? Uyarı mı?

ds:341:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I probably should be – but I’m so curious!

ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The rest of the critters say they’ve never seen this. They say it looks ominous. But I think it looks pretty!
ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Diğer hayvancıklar hiç böyle bir şey görmediklerini söylüyor. Uğursuz göründüğünü düşünüyorlar. Ama bence çok güzel!

ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dostum, gezgin olabilirim… Ama bu hayvancıklar beni kendilerinden biri gibi görüyor. Başlarına kötü bir şey gelsin istemiyorum…

ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m doing well.
What do you make of all this?
ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.target:
İyiyim.
Bütün bunlar hakkında ne düşünüyorsun?

ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I’m kinda scared… But also ready.

ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, I don’t know what’s coming up, but I’m prepared to do my part. Whatever needs to be done.
ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Evet, ne olacağını bilmiyorum ama üzerime düşeni yapmaya hazırım. Ne gerekirse.

ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…
ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dostum, gezgin olabilirim… Ama bu hayvancıklar beni kendilerinden biri gibi görüyor. Başlarına kötü bir şey gelsin istemiyorum…

ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to tell them a few times now. I’m pretty sure there’s nothin to worry about.
ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Birkaç kez anlatmaya çalıştım. Endişelenecek bir şey olmadığından epey eminim.

ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, I recall stumbling across a writing that mentioned something like this.
ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Uzun zaman önce buna benzer bir şeyden söz eden bir yazıyla karşılaştığımı hatırlıyorum.

ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though the writing didn’t mention why, or what it meant – it definitely didn’t mention any cataclysmic events afterward.
ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yazıda nedeni ya da anlamı belirtilmese de sonrasında felaket boyutunda bir olaydan kesinlikle bahsedilmiyordu.

ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perhaps this is just a temporary phenomenon. Perhaps it’s something much more…
ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Belki sadece geçici bir olaydır. Belki çok daha fazlasıdır…

ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I don’t think anything bad will come of it.

ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to calm the critters down, but some of them can be pretty creative and get themselves worked up, heh.
ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hayvancıkları sakinleştirmeye çalıştım ama bazıları hayal gücünü fazla çalıştırıp kendi kendine telaşlanıyor, heh.

ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I figured my time would be better spent studying this while it’s happening.
ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Vaktimi bunu olup biterken araştırmaya ayırmam daha iyi olur diye düşündüm.

ds:343:17:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, I should get back to it!

ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It didn’t make too much sense at the time, I thought perhaps I misinterpreted it, or perhaps it was a metaphor.
ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]O zaman pek anlamlı gelmemişti, belki yanlış yorumladım ya da bir mecazdır diye düşündüm.

ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]This is truly a sight to behold! I’ve never seen anything like this!
ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Gerçekten görülmeye değer! Böyle bir şey hiç görmedim!

ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s so much to gleam from all of this.
ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ama bütün bunlardan öğrenilecek çok şey var.

ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look, even the glyphs that are broken off of the monolith are glowing.

ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should see my collection back home, so many little runes glowing ever so slightly. [pic=3]When I first saw it, I thought I was going mad!
ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Evdeki koleksiyonumu görmelisin, bir sürü küçük runik işaret hafif hafif parlıyor. [pic=3]İlk gördüğümde aklımı kaçırıyorum sandım!

ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.source:
A lot of the critters seem worried,
do you think this is a problem?
ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.target:
Birçok hayvancık endişeli görünüyor,
sence bu bir sorun mu?

ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal, what’s all the commotion going on?

ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s some stuff going on in the ruins.
You might wanna check it out!
ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.target:
Harabelerde bir şeyler oluyor.
Bir bakmak isteyebilirsin!

ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ruins? I’ve never seen any ruins here… but that sounds pretty interesting…
ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Harabe mi? Burada hiç harabe görmedim… ama kulağa ilginç geliyor…

ds:345:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard there’s some exciting things happening? I was about to go check it out.

ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, the ruins have started glowing.
It’s pretty whacky.
ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.target:
Evet, harabeler parlamaya başladı.
Epey acayip.

ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hmm, that’s quite bizarre. I’ll have to go see for myself.
ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hımm, çok tuhaf. Gidip kendi gözümle görmeliyim.

ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, I hear there’s some crazy stuff going on…
ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Selam Kızıl, çılgın şeyler oluyormuş diye duydum…

ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, some of the ruins are glowing…
You should check it out!
ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.target:
Evet, harabelerin bir kısmı parlıyor…
Gidip görmelisin!

ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep, just closing up the shop here first. Definitely gotta see this for myself…
ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Evet, önce dükkânı kapatıyorum. Bunu kesinlikle kendi gözümle görmeliyim…

ds:347:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, let’s make a trip out there soon…

ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, as I was saying – your sweater is all done!

ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wait… there’s still a couple pins here…
ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dur… Şurada hâlâ birkaç toplu iğne var…

ds:347:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I agree! We did quite well with this one!

ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.source: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)
ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.target: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)

ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There he is! Good timing too, we just finished!
ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]İşte geldi! Tam da zamanında, yeni bitirdik!

ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes, that’s pretty normal. This is your first time, right?
ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Evet, gayet normal. İlk kez giyiyorsun, değil mi?

ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The fur can mingle with the cloth – but after a while it gets more comfortable
ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kürk kumaşa karışabiliyor ama bir süre sonra daha rahat oluyor

ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, when you look this fabulous, you can’t complain!
ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ama hey, böyle muhteşem görünürken şikâyet edemezsin!

ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, don’t worry – You can wear it when you need to.

ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But uh, what was all that hubbub about?

ds:347:40:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You won’t hurt our feelings by not wearing it.

ds:347:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’d prefer to see you nude anyways.

ds:347:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let us know if any seams come loose.

ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All of our clothes have a life time guarantee!

ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Something’s going on.
Some of the glyphs at the ruins are glowing.
ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.target:
Bir şeyler oluyor.
Harabelerdeki bazı işaretler parlıyor.

ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah~ That was fun! We ought to do that again real soon!
ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah~ Çok eğlenceliydi! Çok yakında yine yapmalıyız!

ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.source:
Definitely! Hopefully I can
last longer next time…
ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.target:
Kesinlikle! Umarım bir dahaki sefere
daha uzun dayanabilirim…

ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.source:
I think I have a soft spot
for you smaller critters…
ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.target:
Sanırım siz küçük hayvancıklara
karşı zaafım var…

ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Magic Mabel Touch! No one can resist it!
ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Bu, Mabel’in Sihirli Dokunuşu! Kimse karşı koyamaz!

ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gotta say though, that tongue-bath was doin’ things for me.
ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ama şunu söyleyeyim, o dil banyosu beni bir hoş etti.

ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s definitely a big button for me!
ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Beni kesinlikle çok tahrik eden bir şey!

ds:348:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Whew! Well that was a productive day!

ds:348:515:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m going to head back and chill.

ds:348:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes! We should do this again sometime!

ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say big guy, you free for a bit?
ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]İri dostum, biraz boş vaktin var mı?

ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We were wondering if ya wanted to take us up on that romping we mentioned earlier…
ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Daha önce bahsettiğimiz oynaşma teklifini kabul eder misin diye düşünüyorduk…

ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been stretching all day! Now we can put some of that to the test!
ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Bütün gün esnetme yaptık! Artık bir kısmını test edebiliriz!

ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not gonna lie, mate, always kinda wanted to have your claws riggling inside me…
ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yalan yok dostum, pençelerinin içimde kıpırdanmasını hep biraz istemişimdir…

ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That sounds great! Some good ole’ fashion finger blasting!

ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.source:
An order of finger blasting,
coming right up!

ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha ok you two, follow me. There’s a secluded area behind the bushes over there…
ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, tamam siz ikiniz, peşimden gelin. Şuradaki çalıların arkasında tenha bir yer var…

ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ok Rascal! Lay on your back over there…

ds:349:323:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Now let’s climb on top of him.

ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.source: Damn mate, already flyin’ full mast eh?
ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.target: Vay dostum, yelkenler çoktan tam açılmış, ha?

ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, I think we’re ready… Watch those claws!
ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.target: Tamam, hazırız sanırım… O pençelere dikkat!

ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.source: This is so much better than our toys Mabel!
ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.target: Bu oyuncaklarımızdan çok daha iyi Mabel!

ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.source: You two are pretty dang loose! That stretching is paying off!
ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.target: İkiniz de epey gevşeksiniz! O esnetmeler işe yarıyor!

ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.source: We’ve been working on depth too! I bet you can get two knuckles deep on me!
ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.target: Derinlik için de çalışıyoruz! Bence bende iki boğuma kadar girebilirsin!

ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, don’t go much further for me, mate!
ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.target: Hımm, bende çok daha ileri gitme dostum!

ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.source: You’re right up on my prostate-nnngawd it feels great!

ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Dustin, gimme a hand with this guy. I wanna see him squirt~!
ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.target: Hey Dustin, şununla bana yardım et. Fışkırmasını görmek istiyorum~!

ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, that’s right mate, let it all out~
ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.target: Hımm, işte böyle dostum, hepsini bırak~

ds:349:357:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh Dustin, you got some on your face…

ds:349:361:Dialogue Text.source: Come here, I can clean you two up…

ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.source: The very fibers of your being vibrate with joy.

ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.source: It is… an extremely magnificent piece…
ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.target: Bu… son derece muhteşem bir eser…

ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.source: Standing in the presence of this piece makes you feel complete. Nay, FULFILLED!
ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.target: Bu eserin huzurunda kendini tamamlanmış hissediyorsun. Hayır, DOYUMA ULAŞMIŞ!

ds:350:37:Dialogue Text.source: This stone… It’s warm to the touch…

ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.source: You can feel an immense power flowing from within…
ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.target: İçinden muazzam bir gücün aktığını hissedebiliyorsun…

ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kusura bakma Afacan, şu an bir işin ortasındayım... Biraz zaman ver...

ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...
ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kusura bakma Afacan, şu an bir işin ortasındayım... Biraz zaman ver...

ds:352:49:Dialogue Text.source: A bit! Those ruins were quite something!

ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope they don’t scare ya off! I’ve grown used to your company!

ds:352:52:Dialogue Text.source: Nah, I’m here for the long run.

ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal! Good work again on the bridge! We appreciate your help!
ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Afacan! Köprüde yine iyi iş çıkardın! Yardımına minnettarız!

ds:352:56:Dialogue Text.source: No problem! We make a great team!

ds:352:58:Dialogue Text.source: Let me know if you guys need anything else!

ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Our little town has some pretty interesting things going on huh?
ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Küçük kasabamızda epey ilginç şeyler oluyor, ha?

ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok not gonna lie, things got a lot more interesting when you arrived…
ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tamam, yalan yok, sen gelince işler çok daha ilginçleşti…

ds:353:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey so… When are we going on a date?

ds:353:37:Dialogue Text.source: We can go right now if you’d like!

ds:353:39:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Bah, I’ve got a thing in a bit…

ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.source: No worries, you tell me when you’re ready!
ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.target: Sorun değil, hazır olunca sen söyle!

ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! Whattya think about those runes?
ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.target: Evet! O runik işaretler hakkında ne düşünüyorsun?

ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s mysterious! Adventerous! I feel like I’m in a book or something!
ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Gizemli! Macera dolu! Kendimi bir kitabın içinde gibi hissediyorum!

ds:355:23:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Burada hiç sıkıcı an yok, değil mi?

ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…

ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!
ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ben sadece o runik işaretlerin parlamayı bırakmasına sevindim!

ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!
ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bunu duymak harika! Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa söyle canım~!

ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You should let us dress you up sometime.
ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bir ara seni giydirip süslememize izin vermelisin.

ds:356:141:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not so sure about that one…

ds:356:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What did you make of those ruins?

ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I put it as an accent for my hat! It was spectacular while it was glowing!

ds:356:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But when the glowing stopped, I ditched it.

ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon Vi, you’re telling me you wouldn’t do the same?
ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hadi Vi, sen aynısını yapmaz mıydın yani?

ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*
ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*

ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Those glowing glyphs gave me some wicked cool ideas.
ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]O parlayan işaretler bana acayip havalı fikirler verdi.

ds:357:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’ll paint a series on it…

ds:357:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]About the stones? I mean, it’s pretty damn weird…

ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But uh, nothing bad seems to have happened.
ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ama şey, kötü bir şey olmamış gibi görünüyor.

ds:357:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Things sure are pickin’ up with you around.

ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Somethin’ tells me things are just getting started!
ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Evet! İçimden bir ses daha yeni başlıyoruz diyor!

ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Rascal! Gosh, I’ve been learning a lot of stuff here!
ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Afacan! Tanrım, burada bir sürü şey öğreniyorum!

ds:358:163:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Do you know what’s going on?

ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve cross referenced a few things, and this has indeed happened before.
ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Birkaç şeyi karşılaştırdım, bu gerçekten daha önce olmuş.

ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But it was a VERY long time ago. Which is great news!
ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ama ÇOK uzun zaman önce. Bu da harika haber!

ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’d love to chat Rascal, but I’ve got a lot of stuff to look through.
ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sohbet etmek isterdim Afacan ama inceleyecek çok şeyim var.

ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now that stuff’s gettin’ a lil weird in the forest, training is more important than ever!
ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ormanda işler biraz tuhaflaştığına göre antrenman her zamankinden önemli!

ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got a new routine set up if you’d like to give it a shot!

ds:359:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Novice level! Whattya say, mate??

ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.source: Actually let’s do the Training Routine.

ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.source: On second thought, I’ll pass for now.
ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.target: Bir daha düşündüm de şimdilik pas geçeyim.

ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oooh, ya wanna try the Novice Track, eh? Great!
ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ooo, Acemi Parkurunu denemek istiyorsun, ha? Harika!

ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So this one’s gonna be a lil different, mate, so pay attention!
ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bu biraz farklı olacak dostum, o yüzden dikkatini ver!

ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]First, this one will be a bit longer. I’ve got a bit of a routine set up for ya!
ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Öncelikle bu biraz daha uzun. Sana bir program hazırladım!

ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Second, unlike the training, I’ll be going a lot harder are on ya, mate. So keep your eyes peeled!!
ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]İkincisi, alıştırmanın aksine sana çok daha sert davranacağım dostum. Gözlerini dört aç!!

ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That said, I don’t want to hurt you, so i’ll stop the training if you get hit more than 3 times!
ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ama seni incitmek istemiyorum, o yüzden 3 kereden fazla vurulursan antrenmanı durduracağım!

ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.source: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*
ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.target: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*

ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.source: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*
ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.target: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*

ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…

ds:359:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.source: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*
ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.target: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*

ds:359:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I got ya pretty good there, eh?

ds:359:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You’ll have to be quicker next time!

ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But eh, sorry if I went a lil hard!
ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ama eh, biraz sert davrandıysam kusura bakma!

ds:359:245:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Let me know if you want to try again!

ds:359:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!

ds:359:248:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m gonna have to really step it up!

ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next challenge I’ll have for ya will be really tough, just you wait!
ds:359:249:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sonraki mücadelem çok zor olacak, bekle de gör!

ds:359:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m impressed! Happy to call you my pupil!

ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Looks like I got ya a couple times. But still, you beat the challenge!
ds:359:254:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sana birkaç kez vurdum galiba. Ama yine de mücadeleyi geçtin!

ds:359:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…

ds:359:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dang mate! You’re gettin’ really good at this!

ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You win the personal satisfaction knowing your body and mind are growing healthier!
ds:359:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bedeninin ve zihninin daha sağlıklı olduğunu bilmenin verdiği kişisel tatmini kazanıyorsun!

ds:359:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Well how about a romp in the bushes with your trainer?

ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Whew! I don’t think I’m gonna be able to take that knot anytime soon…
ds:359:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Üf! O düğümü yakın zamanda içime alabileceğimi sanmıyorum…

ds:359:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not sure if this is something practice can make happen…

ds:359:763:Dialogue Text.source: I’m impressed you can fit me at all!

ds:359:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah, well mate, you gotta give me some credit!

ds:359:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m not your typical squirrel, after all.

ds:359:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anyways, you keep up the good work!

ds:359:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The next routine will be even more challenging!

ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, this looks like it’s going to be a long walk!
ds:35:18:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm, bu uzun bir yürüyüş olacak gibi görünüyor!

ds:360:62:Dialogue Text.source: A piercing cold shoots through your body.

ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I pulled a lot of the hues from the glowing runes!
ds:360:66:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Değil mi? Tonların çoğunu o parlayan runik işaretlerden aldım!

ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’ve got this chilling quality to them, had to capture it!
ds:360:67:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]İnsanın içini ürperten bir yanları var, yakalamam lazımdı!

ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? I wanted to capture this vast space.
ds:360:69:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Değil mi? Bu engin alanı yakalamak istedim.

ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Something that’s been there all along. Undisturbed, for centuries!
ds:360:70:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Başından beri orada olan bir şey. Yüzyıllardır dokunulmamış!

ds:360:72:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thanks buddy! Pretty proud of this one!
ds:360:72:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sağ ol dostum! Bununla epey gurur duyuyorum!

ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.source: A spacious illustration, featuring stunning crystal structures.
ds:360:74:Dialogue Text.target: Çarpıcı kristal yapıları gösteren, engin bir manzara resmi.

ds:360:76:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.
ds:360:76:Dialogue Text.target: Tabloya bakarken vücudundan bir ürperti geçiyor.

ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.source: Where could such a place be? What could reside there?
ds:360:78:Dialogue Text.target: Böyle bir yer nerede olabilir? Orada ne yaşıyor olabilir?

ds:361:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh not much. Just doing some shopping…
ds:361:264:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, pek bir şey yok. Biraz alışveriş yapıyorum…

ds:362:321:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See! He’s right there! Ask him now!

ds:362:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I think I want to give it a go!

ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But the thing is… I wanna ease into it, with a lil private version, y’know?
ds:362:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Ama mesele şu… Küçük, özel bir versiyonla yavaş yavaş alışmak istiyorum, anlıyor musun?

ds:362:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I’m a little strange when it comes to my intimate partners…

ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Either I know them very well like Scarlett here…
ds:362:343:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ya buradaki Scarlett gibi çok iyi tanımam gerekiyor…

ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Or it’s a lot easier to do something uh… "unique" like this with folks I don’t know too well…
ds:362:344:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ya da böyle… “benzersiz” bir şeyi pek tanımadığım kişilerle yapmak çok daha kolay…

ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It can just be a lil awkward for me to try this with our other friends…
ds:362:345:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Bunu diğer dostlarımızla denemek benim için biraz garip olabiliyor…

ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.source: Well yeah! I’ve been doing the same thing here.
ds:362:349:Dialogue Text.target: Evet tabii! Ben de burada aynı şeyi yapıyorum.

ds:362:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See! I told you he’d be down!

ds:362:354:Dialogue Text.source: When and where is this all goin’ down?
ds:362:354:Dialogue Text.target: Bütün bunlar ne zaman, nerede olacak?

ds:362:356:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you aren’t busy now, we can use my basement!

ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]No worries honey, we can take this as slowly as ya want!
ds:362:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Merak etme tatlım, ne kadar yavaş istersen o kadar yavaş ilerleriz!

ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes ya gotta push the bird out of the nest, y’know? Bawkaw!
ds:362:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bazen kuşu yuvadan itmek gerekir, bilirsin? Gaak!

ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! Now bend over so I can get this harness around you…
ds:363:581:Dialogue Text.target: Evet! Şimdi eğil de şu koşumu etrafına geçireyim…

ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.source: OK! I’m gonna put this ball gag on ya now, are ya ready?
ds:363:582:Dialogue Text.target: Tamam! Şimdi şu top ağız tıkacını takacağım, hazır mısın?

ds:363:586:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, do you want blinders on?

ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.source: No, not this time. I’d like to see!
ds:363:588:Dialogue Text.target: Hayır, bu sefer değil. Görmek istiyorum!

ds:363:591:Dialogue Text.source: How’s the view back there Rascal?

ds:363:593:Dialogue Text.source: Lookin’ great! Let me know when she’s ready!

ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.source: Aww look how cute she is with that ballgag on.
ds:363:596:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, şu top ağız tıkacıyla ne kadar tatlı olduğuna bak.

ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.source: Oop, you’re drooling a bit, lemme get that for ya!
ds:363:598:Dialogue Text.target: Aa, biraz salyan akıyor, dur sileyim!

ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.source: I’m gonna start warming her up back here, is that ok!
ds:363:602:Dialogue Text.target: Ben burada onu hazırlamaya başlayacağım, olur mu!

ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, that’s my girl! She’s my absolute favorite to play with for that very reason!
ds:363:610:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, işte benim kızım! Tam da bu yüzden en sevdiğim oyun arkadaşım o!

ds:363:612:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I’m gonna go for it.

ds:363:620:Dialogue Text.source: How are ya doin’ back there?

ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.source: Haven’t done this with a bird before!
ds:363:623:Dialogue Text.target: Bunu daha önce bir kuşla yapmamıştım!

ds:363:628:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, she’s close, I can tell.

ds:363:639:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh Rascal, you were really gettin’ in there!

ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya blame me? You’re so soft back here!
ds:363:641:Dialogue Text.target: Beni suçlayabilir misin? Buran çok yumuşak!

ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal… You know there’s two holes in there, right?
ds:363:644:Dialogue Text.target: Afacan… Orada iki delik olduğunu biliyorsun, değil mi?

ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, y’know. I thought I felt something different every so often…
ds:363:646:Dialogue Text.target: Ooo, biliyor musun? Ara sıra farklı bir şey hissettiğimi düşünmüştüm…

ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.source: You are my first bird. I hope I didn’t hurt you.
ds:363:647:Dialogue Text.target: İlk kuş partnerim sensin. Umarım canını yakmadım.

ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.source: No no, it was quite exciting! I didn’t know what to expect, and that’s the whole allure of this thing!
ds:363:649:Dialogue Text.target: Yok yok, çok heyecanlıydı! Ne bekleyeceğimi bilmiyordum, zaten bu işin bütün cazibesi bu!

ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.source: Gah, dear you’re so cute when you’re satisfied, I simply must smooch you~
ds:363:651:Dialogue Text.target: Ah canım, tatmin olunca öyle tatlı oluyorsun ki seni öpmem şart~

ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.source: Baww haha, thanks for this you two…
ds:363:653:Dialogue Text.target: Bahaha, bunun için teşekkürler ikinize de…

ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.source: Think you’re ready to go public?
ds:363:655:Dialogue Text.target: Herkese açık yapmaya hazır mısın sence?

ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.source: Haha that’s ok- Oh, I think she wants the gag out.
ds:363:661:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, sorun değil- Aa, sanırım tıkacı çıkarmamızı istiyor.

ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.source: But I definitely want to do this again…
ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.target: Ama bunu kesinlikle yine yapmak istiyorum…

ds:363:666:Dialogue Text.source: I haven’t had a go with ya yet!

ds:363:667:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve got a few toys I think you’d love…

ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, I’d love to see that! But gosh I’m beat.
ds:363:671:Dialogue Text.target: Ooo, bunu görmek isterdim! Ama tanrım, bittim.

ds:363:672:Dialogue Text.source: I think I’ll leave you two to it!

ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.source: Aw, ok hun. Thanks for helping me out!
ds:363:674:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, tamam tatlım. Bana yardım ettiğin için teşekkürler!

ds:363:676:Dialogue Text.source: We’ll catch you up on our shenanigans later!

ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for warming her up for me!
ds:363:677:Dialogue Text.target: Onu benim için hazırladığın için teşekkürler!

ds:363:678:Dialogue Text.source: Now for the real fun to begin…

ds:364:25:Dialogue Text.source: The entrance is a little bit of a squeeze…
ds:364:25:Dialogue Text.target: Girişten geçmek için biraz sıkışmak gerekiyor…

ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.source: You can see a lot of miscellaneous cloth materials scattered about.
ds:364:26:Dialogue Text.target: Etrafa saçılmış çeşit çeşit kumaş malzeme görebiliyorsun.

ds:365:30:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like the path continues here…

ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.source: This must be where Augustus lives… But he’s not home at the moment…
ds:366:33:Dialogue Text.target: Augustus burada yaşıyor olmalı… Ama şu an evde değil…

ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.source: You can make out a bunch of papers and rocks inside.
ds:366:34:Dialogue Text.target: İçeride bir sürü kâğıt ve taş seçebiliyorsun.

ds:367:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hmm… This one I didn’t quite finish…

ds:367:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Kinda got bored of it halway through.

ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Instead of wasting my time or paint, it’s a better idea to just stop and try something else.
ds:367:87:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Vaktimi ya da boyamı harcamaktansa durup başka bir şey denemek daha iyi.

ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.source: A vast space, with a single illuminated rune.
ds:367:88:Dialogue Text.target: Tek bir aydınlık runik işaretin olduğu engin bir alan.

ds:367:90:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think I’ll try this one again sometime.

ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I had a striking idea in my head, but as I started painting, the idea kinda shifted to this.
ds:367:91:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aklımda çarpıcı bir fikir vardı ama resme başlayınca fikir biraz buna dönüştü.

ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But it’s not as striking as I wanted it to be, so maybe next time.
ds:367:92:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ama istediğim kadar çarpıcı olmadı, belki bir dahaki sefere.

ds:367:97:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.
ds:367:97:Dialogue Text.target: Tabloya bakarken vücudundan bir ürperti geçiyor.

ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.source: As you focus on the symbol, you could feel your vision tunneling…
ds:367:99:Dialogue Text.target: Sembole odaklandıkça görüş alanının daraldığını hissediyorsun…

ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.source: Looks spooky! Do you often to portraits?
ds:368:105:Dialogue Text.target: Ürkütücü görünüyor! Sık sık portre yapar mısın?

ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I don’t! Well, not for fun at least.
ds:368:106:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Yapmam! Yani en azından keyif için değil.

ds:368:107:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I do the occasional study here and there.

ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But I dreamt this figure up a bit ago. I had to try to capture it!
ds:368:108:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ama bu figürü bir süre önce rüyamda gördüm. Onu yakalamayı denemem lazımdı!

ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I don’t think I fully got it… but… still came out pretty well.
ds:368:109:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tam yakaladığımı sanmıyorum… ama… yine de epey iyi oldu.

ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.source:
Say, are there creatures
like that in this forest?
ds:368:112:Dialogue Text.target:
Peki bu ormanda
böyle yaratıklar var mı?

ds:368:113:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Not that I’ve seen! But who knows.

ds:368:115:Dialogue Text.source: A fierce creature peers back at you.

ds:368:117:Dialogue Text.source: A chill runs through your body while peering over the painting.
ds:368:117:Dialogue Text.target: Tabloya bakarken vücudundan bir ürperti geçiyor.

ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.source: Its eyes are captivating… They seem to be analyzing everything about you…
ds:368:119:Dialogue Text.target: Gözleri büyüleyici… Sanki senin her yanını inceliyorlar…

ds:369:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s a few other critters that you’ve yet to meet.

ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll go ahead and jot them down in your Quest Log - I’m sure you’ll meet them on your own. But you can read up on it there!
ds:369:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Onları Görev Defterine not edeyim, eminim kendi başına tanışırsın. Ama oradan okuyabilirsin!

ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Once you’ve met all the critters here, I’ll have a special request for ya!
ds:369:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Buradaki bütün hayvancıklarla tanışınca senden özel bir isteğim olacak!

ds:36:17:Dialogue Text.source: this convo exists so we can ensure all quest steps have a nonnull db conversation (saves a heckton of null checks in the source code!)
ds:36:17:Dialogue Text.target: this convo exists so we can ensure all quest steps have a nonnull db conversation (saves a heckton of null checks in the source code!)

ds:370:585:Dialogue Text.source: He does, doesn’t he? That’s Rascal, he’s new around here.
ds:370:585:Dialogue Text.target: Öyle, değil mi? O Afacan, buralarda yeni.

ds:370:586:Dialogue Text.source: He heard about some of our lil parties, and wanted to be in the center of it!
ds:370:586:Dialogue Text.target: Küçük partilerimizi duymuş, ortasında olmak istemiş!

ds:370:591:Dialogue Text.source: Mmmm, damn Claire… Get in there…

ds:370:595:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I like watchin’ this lil guy squirmin’ around!
ds:370:595:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, şu ufaklığın kıvranmasını izlemek hoşuma gidiyor!

ds:370:599:Dialogue Text.source: That’s right! Let’s see who’s got the most spunk!
ds:370:599:Dialogue Text.target: Aynen! Bakalım kimde en çok döl var!

ds:370:601:Dialogue Text.source: I’d like to be in the center of him…

ds:370:603:Dialogue Text.source: Hold your horses, cowboy! This is just a squirt show.
ds:370:603:Dialogue Text.target: Acele etme kovboy! Bu sadece fışkırtma gösterisi.

ds:370:606:Dialogue Text.source: But uh, give him my number later, yeah?
ds:370:606:Dialogue Text.target: Ama şey, ona sonra numaramı ver, olur mu?

ds:370:608:Dialogue Text.source: Ok ok. For now you go over there.
ds:370:608:Dialogue Text.target: Tamam tamam. Şimdilik sen şuraya geç.

ds:370:609:Dialogue Text.source: And you over here. And you over there!
ds:370:609:Dialogue Text.target: Sen de buraya. Sen de şuraya!

ds:370:611:Dialogue Text.source: You know who’s gonna win that Claire…

ds:370:613:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, we had ya leaking from both ends last time…
ds:370:613:Dialogue Text.target: Evet, geçen sefer iki ucundan da akıtmıştık…

ds:370:614:Dialogue Text.target: Afacan’ı aramıza alıp sandviç yapmaya hayır demem…

ds:370:628:Dialogue Text.source: Alright boys, let us have it!

ds:370:629:Dialogue Text.source: *Flash White, fade to Dude Bukkake with Cum*
ds:370:629:Dialogue Text.target: *Flash White, fade to Dude Bukkake with Cum*

ds:370:631:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, you’re all lookin’ cute covered in my spunk…
ds:370:631:Dialogue Text.target: Hımm, dölümle kaplanınca hepiniz tatlı görünüyorsunuz…

ds:370:633:Dialogue Text.source: Alright tough guy, come and clean up your mess.
ds:370:633:Dialogue Text.target: Tamam kabadayı, gel de pisliğini temizle.

ds:370:637:Dialogue Text.source: Let me get in on some of that!

ds:370:639:Dialogue Text.source: C’mon in boys, the waters warm!

ds:370:642:Dialogue Text.source: Wheeeeew! Ok, I need some water. Damn, you guys are machines.
ds:370:642:Dialogue Text.target: Üüüf! Tamam, su lazım. Vay be, makine gibisiniz.

ds:370:644:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, for once, I could use a break.
ds:370:644:Dialogue Text.target: Eveet, bu seferlik ben de mola versem iyi olur.

ds:370:648:Dialogue Text.source: That was fun lil’ guy, hit us up if you want some time.
ds:370:648:Dialogue Text.target: Eğlenceliydi ufaklık, bir ara istersen haber ver.

ds:371:660:Dialogue Text.source: How about you, Rascal, ya ready for this?
ds:371:660:Dialogue Text.target: Peki ya sen Afacan, buna hazır mısın?

ds:371:668:Dialogue Text.source: Heh… Thanks for helping out… I’ve never done this sort of thing before…
ds:371:668:Dialogue Text.target: Heh… Yardım ettiğin için teşekkürler… Daha önce hiç böyle bir şey yapmadım…

ds:371:672:Dialogue Text.source: We can do some one on one later if you’re interested…
ds:371:672:Dialogue Text.target: İlgilenirsen sonra baş başa da bir şeyler yapabiliriz…

ds:371:676:Dialogue Text.source: How’s the view down there Rascal?

ds:371:678:Dialogue Text.source: Amazing! I don’t think I’ve ever been in the middle of so many lovely ladies!
ds:371:678:Dialogue Text.target: Muhteşem! Bu kadar güzel hanımın ortasında hiç bulunmamıştım galiba!

ds:371:680:Dialogue Text.source: This is a first for me, that’s for sure!

ds:371:681:Dialogue Text.source: It’s nice to be on giving end for once, am I right ladies?
ds:371:681:Dialogue Text.target: Bir kez de veren tarafta olmak güzel, değil mi hanımlar?

ds:371:683:Dialogue Text.source: Certainly less clean up on my end!
ds:371:683:Dialogue Text.target: Benim açımdan temizlenecek şey kesinlikle daha az!

ds:371:684:Dialogue Text.source: Though, can’t say I mind that part…
ds:371:684:Dialogue Text.target: Gerçi o kısma itirazım var diyemem…

ds:371:686:Dialogue Text.source: You ladies have some really interesting methods!

ds:371:689:Dialogue Text.source: It’s great on the wrists! For longer sessions, of course…
ds:371:689:Dialogue Text.target: Bileklere iyi geliyor! Uzun seanslarda tabii…

ds:371:692:Dialogue Text.source: Say Rascal, can ya do me a favor?
ds:371:692:Dialogue Text.target: Afacan, bana bir iyilik yapar mısın?

ds:371:696:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya lap up some of your pre?

ds:371:702:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah? Would you ladies like that?
ds:371:702:Dialogue Text.target: Öyle mi? Hoşunuza gider mi hanımlar?

ds:371:706:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, the least I could do for a show like this!
ds:371:706:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, böyle bir gösteri için az bile!

ds:371:708:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, this gals starting to buck!

ds:371:710:Dialogue Text.source: Hahh- Sorry~! Just getting into it!

ds:371:712:Dialogue Text.source: Not at all sweetie, you enjoy yourself.
ds:371:712:Dialogue Text.target: Hiç sorun değil tatlım, sen keyfine bak.

ds:371:713:Dialogue Text.source: The rest of you ladies though, let’s see if we can pick up the pace for Rascal’s first round!
ds:371:713:Dialogue Text.target: Diğer hanımlar, Afacan’ın ilk turu için tempoyu biraz artırabilir miyiz bakalım!

ds:371:717:Dialogue Text.source: Alright ladies, let’s not hold anything back~!

ds:371:724:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh~ Look at that cum piling up on Rascal…
ds:371:724:Dialogue Text.target: Tanrım~ Afacan’ın üstünde biriken döle bak…

ds:371:725:Dialogue Text.source: I’m calling dibs on cleaning him!

ds:371:727:Dialogue Text.source: No fair! I wanted in on that!

ds:371:729:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, ladies, I’m absolutely drenched - there’s plenty to go around!
ds:371:729:Dialogue Text.target: Haha hanımlar, sırılsıklamım, herkese yetecek kadar var!

ds:371:731:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, this big ole cutie’s going for round 2 already!
ds:371:731:Dialogue Text.target: Ooo, şu koca tatlı şey şimdiden 2. tura geçiyor!

ds:371:733:Dialogue Text.source: Nnnfff~ I’m sorry! I can’t- *shudder* control it!

ds:371:737:Dialogue Text.source: Right? Honey, please, keep it coming!
ds:371:737:Dialogue Text.target: Değil mi? Tatlım, lütfen devam et!

ds:371:739:Dialogue Text.source: Whattya gals say, anyone wanna start cleaning me up?
ds:371:739:Dialogue Text.target: Ne dersiniz kızlar, beni temizlemeye başlamak isteyen var mı?

ds:371:748:Dialogue Text.source: Please, my tongue is sore haha!

ds:371:750:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, my paws are getting pruney…

ds:371:752:Dialogue Text.source: That was, SO MUCH FUN! Thank you for inviting me!
ds:371:752:Dialogue Text.target: ÇOK EĞLENCELİYDİ! Davet ettiğiniz için teşekkürler!

ds:371:756:Dialogue Text.source: Hit us up for the next one!

ds:372:324:Dialogue Text.source:
Not too much!
Just seeing what you lovely ladies are up to!
ds:372:324:Dialogue Text.target:
Pek bir şey yok!
Siz güzel hanımlar ne yapıyor diye bakıyorum!

ds:372:326:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We were actually just making some plans for tonight.

ds:372:329:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh, funny you ask. Are you free right now?
ds:372:329:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Heh, sorman iyi oldu. Şu an boş musun?

ds:372:332:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! We wanted to take you up on your rain check!

ds:372:333:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You remember that, right? You said you want in on the next bukkake!
ds:372:333:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hatırlıyorsun, değil mi? Bir sonraki bukkake’ye katılmak istediğini söyledin!

ds:372:335:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well it just so happens we’ve got a few of our lady friends coming over in a bit…
ds:372:335:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tesadüf bu ya, birazdan birkaç kadın dostumuz geliyor…

ds:372:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well it just so happens we’ve got a few of our male friends coming over in a bit…
ds:372:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tesadüf bu ya, birazdan birkaç erkek dostumuz geliyor…

ds:372:340:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What do YOU say, are you in?

ds:372:376:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That was a blast! You’re a good sport Rascal.
ds:372:376:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Çok eğlenceliydi! Çok iyi ayak uydurdun Afacan.

ds:372:378:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! I’m honored to call you a Bukkake Buddy.
ds:372:378:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kesinlikle! Sana Bukkake Dostu demekten onur duyuyorum.

ds:372:381:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh and uhh, if you wanted to try the other form of bukkake, let me know!
ds:372:381:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aa, bir de şey, öteki bukkake türünü denemek istersen söyle!

ds:372:385:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah we got some lady friends that are interested!

ds:372:396:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah we got some dude friends that are interested!

ds:373:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh? You wanna get into some shenanigans again?

ds:373:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure we could get some friends together.

ds:373:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So what’s on the menu? Ladies? Guys?
ds:373:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Menüde ne var peki? Kadınlar mı? Erkekler mi?

ds:373:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You got it! Let me make some calls…

ds:373:365:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You got it! Let me make some calls…

ds:374:23:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Burada hiç sıkıcı an yok, değil mi?

ds:374:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…

ds:374:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!
ds:374:27:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ben sadece o runik işaretlerin parlamayı bırakmasına sevindim!

ds:374:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!
ds:374:33:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bunu duymak harika! Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa söyle canım~!

ds:375:699:Dialogue Text.source: OK Rascal! You lay down, and let me get comfy.
ds:375:699:Dialogue Text.target: Tamam Afacan! Sen uzan, ben de rahatça yerleşeyim.

ds:375:700:Dialogue Text.source: This position should let me get a bit more of ya in…
ds:375:700:Dialogue Text.target: Bu pozisyonda seni biraz daha fazla içime alabilirim…

ds:375:703:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh, you’re a lot bigger than I remember…

ds:375:705:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, bit off more than you can chew?
ds:375:705:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, boyundan büyük bir işe mi kalkıştın?

ds:375:707:Dialogue Text.source: Naw, naw, I should be good, mate.

ds:375:713:Dialogue Text.source: Gah! That’s it mate, just keep pushin!
ds:375:713:Dialogue Text.target: Gah! İşte böyle dostum, itmeye devam et!

ds:375:715:Dialogue Text.source: You sure? It doesn’t feel like it’s getting much further…
ds:375:715:Dialogue Text.target: Emin misin? Pek ilerlemiyor gibi geliyor…

ds:375:717:Dialogue Text.source: Hold up, mate, lemme wiggle around.

ds:375:721:Dialogue Text.source: Gyaaah, there we goooo. Easy does it, eh?
ds:375:721:Dialogue Text.target: Gyaaah, işte olduuu. Ağır ağır, ha?

ds:375:724:Dialogue Text.source: You sure? I can feel your whole body twitching…
ds:375:724:Dialogue Text.target: Emin misin? Bütün vücudunun seğirdiğini hissediyorum…

ds:375:726:Dialogue Text.source: Y-yeah hah I’m good… It’s just a lot to fit!
ds:375:726:Dialogue Text.target: E-evet hah, iyiyim… Sadece sığdırmak zor!

ds:375:727:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not gonna last long at this rate though…

ds:375:731:Dialogue Text.source: Gah! I’m leakin’ all over the place!

ds:375:732:Dialogue Text.source: Say Rascal, get a few good pumps in, would ya?
ds:375:732:Dialogue Text.target: Afacan, şöyle birkaç güzel pompalama yapar mısın?

ds:375:745:Dialogue Text.source: Naw naw, don’t pull out yet…

ds:375:746:Dialogue Text.source: Lemme enjoy this a bit longer…

ds:376:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah… I’ve uh… practiced a few times too…
ds:376:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Evet… Ben şey… birkaç kez alıştırma da yaptım…

ds:376:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Y’know, just in case the opportunity ever came up…
ds:376:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Olur da bir fırsat çıkarsa diye işte…

ds:376:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, heh… I’ve got a toy for such an occasion!
ds:376:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Şey, heh… Böyle durumlar için bir oyuncağım var!

ds:376:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll try to position it right, and just kinda… ride it!

ds:376:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a lil hard to back up into it on my own… but I can get the job done…
ds:376:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tek başıma geri geri üstüne oturmak biraz zor… ama hallediyorum…

ds:376:141:Dialogue Text.source: You don’t have anyone help you?
ds:376:141:Dialogue Text.target: Sana yardım eden biri yok mu?

ds:376:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]N-no… I don’t usually tell critters about this…

ds:376:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m still working on being more open with folks…

ds:376:144:Dialogue Text.source: Well I’m happy to lend a hand if you’d like!
ds:376:144:Dialogue Text.target: İstersen seve seve bir el atarım!

ds:376:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]If you aren’t at busy at the moment…

ds:376:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I could go for a session right about now.

ds:376:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, well, to be honest, I’ve always wanted to bottom for a big strapping stallion sometime…
ds:376:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, açıkçası bir gün iri yarı bir aygırın altında pasif olmak hep istediğim bir şeydi…

ds:376:153:Dialogue Text.source: You mentioned wanting to be a bottom?

ds:376:277:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh I needed that… thanks a lot for your help!
ds:376:277:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tanrım, buna ihtiyacım vardı… Yardımın için çok teşekkürler!

ds:376:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And thanks for your helping cleaning up, you’re pretty good with that tongue, heh.
ds:376:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Temizliğe yardım ettiğin için de sağ ol, o dili epey iyi kullanıyorsun heh.

ds:376:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Let me know if you wanna mess around again!

ds:376:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I wanna stay in practice… Ya never know when a handsome stallion stud might be coming through…
ds:376:281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Formumu korumak istiyorum… Yakışıklı, güçlü kuvvetli bir aygırın ne zaman yolu düşer bilemezsin…

ds:377:698:Dialogue Text.source: Oh damn, you’re already full mast!

ds:377:700:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, yeah… I’m giddy with excitement!
ds:377:700:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, evet… Heyecandan içim içime sığmıyor!

ds:377:701:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve always wanted a partner so I could try a different pose. Are you ok with that?
ds:377:701:Dialogue Text.target: Farklı bir pozisyon denemek için hep bir partner istemiştim. Sana uyar mı?

ds:377:703:Dialogue Text.source: Yep, let’s do whatever you want!

ds:377:705:Dialogue Text.source: Ok! Let me get on my back…

ds:377:709:Dialogue Text.source: Heh yeah! I can hilt it pretty easily.
ds:377:709:Dialogue Text.target: Heh evet! Kolayca dibine kadar alabiliyorum.

ds:377:712:Dialogue Text.source: In that case, let’s get this baby in!
ds:377:712:Dialogue Text.target: O zaman şu güzelliği içeri sokalım!

ds:377:715:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, I’ll never get tired of this…

ds:377:716:Dialogue Text.source: Say Rascal, can ya pump it in?
ds:377:716:Dialogue Text.target: Afacan, içimde ileri geri pompalayabilir misin?

ds:377:722:Dialogue Text.source: Give it a good push, should be able to hilt it.

ds:377:724:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm! A-are you sure? I’m… pushing, pretty dang hard…
ds:377:724:Dialogue Text.target: Hımm! E-emin misin? Oldukça… sert itiyorum…

ds:377:731:Dialogue Text.source: Wow! I can’t believe you took that!

ds:377:732:Dialogue Text.source: And damn that flare! Can’t imagine taking that thing!
ds:377:732:Dialogue Text.target: Bir de o genişleyen uç! Onu almayı hayal edemiyorum!

ds:377:733:Dialogue Text.source: Guh, this is too hot, I’ve got rub one out!
ds:377:733:Dialogue Text.target: Of, çok ateşli, bir mastürbasyon yapmam lazım!

ds:377:737:Dialogue Text.source: Hahhh. hah… Gosh… What a mess…
ds:377:737:Dialogue Text.target: Hahhh, hah… Tanrım… Ne pislik ama…

ds:377:738:Dialogue Text.source: This is why I wanted to try this position though!
ds:377:738:Dialogue Text.target: Ama bu pozisyonu bu yüzden denemek istemiştim!

ds:377:739:Dialogue Text.source: Ya wanna help clean me up?

ds:377:749:Dialogue Text.source: You sure you can take it?

ds:377:752:Dialogue Text.source: Damn this goes in nice and smooth!
ds:377:752:Dialogue Text.target: Vay be, nasıl da pürüzsüzce giriyor!

ds:378:284:Dialogue Text.source:
I was just talking to Scarlett and Peter
about The Blessing of the Bells
ds:378:284:Dialogue Text.target:
Scarlett’le Peter’la Çanların Kutsaması
hakkında konuşuyordum

ds:378:286:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, they said you got up to
some pretty crazy shenanigans!
ds:378:286:Dialogue Text.target:
Evet, epey çılgın yaramazlıklar
yaptığını söylediler!

ds:378:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah yeah! That was a crazy night!

ds:378:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Did they tell you how absolutely drunk I was, too?
ds:378:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ne kadar sarhoş olduğumu da söylediler mi?

ds:378:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I see! Well, I can tell you a bit about what happened…

ds:378:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But seriously, I had A LOT to drink, and a lot of the events are pretty dang fuzzy…
ds:378:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ama cidden ÇOK içtim, olanların çoğu epey bulanık…

ds:378:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, you might be able to help me figure out what happened…
ds:378:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Biliyor musun, neler olduğunu anlamama yardım edebilirsin…

ds:378:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well we’ve tried to piece this together before, but a lot of the critters keep getting their stories confused.
ds:378:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Daha önce parçaları birleştirmeye çalıştık ama hayvancıklar hikâyeleri karıştırıp duruyor.

ds:378:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I think if we had a non-biased third party collect information, that’s you, then we might be able to figure out what actually happened!
ds:378:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Bence tarafsız bir üçüncü kişi, yani sen, bilgi toplarsa gerçekte neler olduğunu anlayabiliriz!

ds:378:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So last Blessing, I wanted to do something special for the holidays.
ds:378:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Geçen Kutsama’da bayram için özel bir şey yapmak istedim.

ds:378:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Peter and Scarlett were throwing a party at their house, and I asked if I could set up an attraction! They said yes.
ds:378:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Peter’la Scarlett evlerinde parti veriyordu, ben de bir eğlence kurabilir miyim diye sordum! Olur dediler.

ds:378:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It wasn’t exactly related to the holiday, but I thought it would be fun to set up a kissing booth!
ds:378:301:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bayramla tam ilgisi yoktu ama bir öpücük standı kurmak eğlenceli olur dedim!

ds:378:303:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Once you’ve got the whole story, come back to me to corroborate!
ds:378:303:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hikâyenin tamamını öğrenince doğrulamak için bana gel!

ds:378:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Make sure you talk to Penny and Augustus too! They can tell you all about the holiday!
ds:378:304:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Penny ve Augustus’la da mutlaka konuş! Bayramla ilgili her şeyi anlatabilirler!

ds:378:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I think things started to really pick up when Claire and Violet entered the picture…
ds:378:307:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ama işler asıl Claire’le Violet sahneye çıkınca hareketlendi sanırım…

ds:378:308:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Y’know how devious they are, but GOSH are they fun at parties! They can mix a mean cocktail too!
ds:378:308:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ne kadar hin olduklarını bilirsin ama TANRIM, partilerde çok eğlenceliler! Müthiş kokteyl de yapıyorlar!

ds:378:309:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]SOO a few mouse-sized cocktails later, I was feeling pretty good!
ds:378:309:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]YANİ fare boyunda birkaç kokteylden sonra keyfim epey yerindeydi!

ds:378:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The girls said I needed to pay them for the drinks! With smooches! But boy did they have something else in mind!
ds:378:310:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kızlar içkilerin “parasını” ödemem gerektiğini söyledi! Öpücükle! Ama akıllarında bambaşka bir şey varmış!

ds:378:311:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ll be honest… at this point, I had a LOT to drink, so I’m pretty fuzzy about it all…
ds:378:311:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dürüst olayım… O noktada ÇOK içmiştim, her şey epey bulanık…

ds:378:313:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]This brings us to our first interview! Claire and Violet! They’ll know what happened…
ds:378:313:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Böylece ilk görüşmemize geliyoruz! Claire ve Violet! Neler olduğunu bilirler…

ds:378:316:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Once you’ve got the whole story, come back to me to corroborate!
ds:378:316:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hikâyenin tamamını öğrenince doğrulamak için bana gel!

ds:378:317:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Make sure you talk to Penny too! They can tell you all about the holiday!
ds:378:317:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Penny’yle de mutlaka konuş! Bayramla ilgili her şeyi anlatabilir!

ds:379:699:Dialogue Text.source: Y’know, charge a lil eggnog, smooch a cute lil mouse. What’s not to love?
ds:379:699:Dialogue Text.target: Biraz yumurtalı süt kokteyli öde, tatlı küçük fareyi öp. Sevilmeyecek ne var?

ds:379:700:Dialogue Text.source: So all night long, I was exchanging smooches with all the guests of the party!
ds:379:700:Dialogue Text.target: Ben de bütün gece partinin tüm konuklarıyla öpücük takas ettim!

ds:379:701:Dialogue Text.source: It was pretty innocent at first, lil smooches on the cheek, quick pecks on the lips. And nice portions of eggnog, nothing too crazy.
ds:379:701:Dialogue Text.target: Başta gayet masumdu, yanağa küçük öpücükler, dudağa kısa kondurmalar. Güzel porsiyonlarda yumurtalı süt kokteyli, öyle çılgınca bir şey yok.

ds:379:702:Dialogue Text.source: Well as the night crept on, some of the critters started getting pretty sloshed…
ds:379:702:Dialogue Text.target: Ama gece ilerledikçe bazı hayvancıklar epey sarhoş olmaya başladı…

ds:379:704:Dialogue Text.source: I remember making out with Dustin for like, 5 minutes.

ds:379:706:Dialogue Text.source: Then I remember Maverick giving me quite a bit of smooches all over my body…

ds:380:475:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I know we licked her but like…?

ds:380:482:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So Claire and I were eyeing Mable’s kissing booth all night.

ds:380:483:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We just saw her get a full on tongue bath by Finley and we thought we had to get in on that!

ds:380:488:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah yes, those boys are a lot of fun!

ds:380:489:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But I don’t really recall seeing Mabel for the rest of the night after that…
ds:380:489:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Ama sonrasında gecenin geri kalanında Mabel’i gördüğümü pek hatırlamıyorum…

ds:380:491:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Right, that’s the last we saw of her.

ds:380:496:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maybe ask Maverick and Dustin what the four of us got up to too, hehe…

ds:382:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey Rascal! How can I help ya?

ds:382:517:Dialogue Text.source: Can ya tell me about The Blessing last year?
ds:382:517:Dialogue Text.target: Bana geçen yılki Kutsama’yı anlatır mısın?

ds:382:526:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]She looked pretty tuckered out, so I invited her to come rest with me.

ds:382:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]See, I was pretty tired from the evening already, and a bit of alcohol always gets me nice and sleepy.

ds:382:528:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I guess Mabel must’ve had other plans…

ds:382:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can get a little naughty when I’m buzzed, and she was pushing all of my buttons that night.
ds:382:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Çakırkeyifken biraz yaramaz olabiliyorum, o gece de bütün düğmelerime basıyordu.

ds:382:530:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well… one thing lead to another and, gosh I’m so embarrassed!

ds:382:534:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]To be honest, I don’t even really remember the details…

ds:382:536:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I know Peter and Scarlett were close. I could hear them giggling nearby during our… massage…
